issues.detail: The Hebrew 'נִיר רָאשִׁים' means 'fallow ground of the poor' (i.e., the tillage of the poor), not 'đất đai của người cày cấy chăm chỉ' (land of a diligent farmer). The subject is the poor, not a diligent worker. Also, 'בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּט' means 'without justice' (i.e., without judgment/justice), not 'chẳng vì tội lỗi gì' (not because of any sin). The verse contrasts the poor's tillage yielding much food with those who are swept away for lack of justice.
